name: Eron the Relentless
description: Immortal King of the Goblins who makes a deal with Sengir.

description_citations.text: "Sengir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eron the Relentless declares a truce: Aysen feeds his band and they do not kill them.
timeline.quote: "The people of Aysen feed us, and we don't kill them. That's my kind of truce."

citation.text: Truce (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eron steals a dark magic book from Grandmother Sengir's library for the Savant Bernatheen and asks that the last spell in it be cast on him.
timeline.quote: Eron found Grandmother Sengir asleep near a tome and stole it.

citation.text: "Eron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The spell makes Eron immortal and immune to aging.
timeline.quote: Eron discovered he was immortal and immune to aging.

citation.text: "Eron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eron declares himself King of the Goblins at Koskun Keep, is killed and rises again, and the goblins accept him as king.
timeline.quote: He traveled to Koskun Keep , where he declared himself King of the Goblins.

citation.text: "Eron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eron forms a treaty with Aysen to keep his subordinates from invading in exchange for trade of food and goods.
timeline.quote: Eron formed a treaty with Aysen

citation.text: "Eron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eron the Relentless steals a magical tome from Castle Sengir for Bernatheen, gains immortality, and rises to become King of Ulgrotha's Goblins.
timeline.quote: the Human thief Eron gained immortality after stealing a magical tome from Castle Sengir for the wizard Bernatheen

citation.text: "From the Library of Leng", section "The Man Who Would Be King". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sengir makes a deal with Eron, King of the Goblins.
timeline.quote: So, the two worked out a deal

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
